Name: (CP) Pierre Sells Rare Seeds
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]💰 Description 💰[/size][size=3]
This mod adds Rare Seeds to Pierre's stock if you've given him his missing stocklist. Since the Traveling Merchant overprices everything he sells, the price at Pierre's shop should be 400g, but that's very unbalanced, so I've given you the choice to set it at 1,000g too. Rare Seeds are the very last seed in his shop, right above Grass Starters.

[size=5][size=5]💰[/size] Installing [size=5]💰[/size][/size][size=3]
[/size]🪙 Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
🪙 Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
🪙 Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional - you can manually edit my config.json file instead)
🪙 Drop this mod's folder ([CP] Pierre Sells Rare Seeds) in your mods folder
[/size][size=2][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Full guide on how to install mods in Stardew Valley[/url][/size]

[size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size] Uninstalling [size=5]💰[/size]
[/size]Just delete my mod's folder and you're good to go!
[/size]
[size=3][size=5][size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size] Compatibility [size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
[size=3][size=3]🪙 [/size]Incompatible with any mods that remove Grass Starters from Pierre's Shop. Let me know if you find any and I'll make a patch.[/size]
[size=3]🪙 Only tested with game version 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0.0+, and Content Patcher 2.0.0+
[size=3]🪙 [/size]I don't know if it works with Nexus Mod Manager, please let me know![/size]

[size=3][size=5][size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size] Permissions [size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size]
[/size][/size][size=3]You can do whatever you want with my mod and its code as long as you don't make money from it. Please ask for permission first, but if I don't answer in 24 hours just go ahead and do it. The mod is translation-ready, so just send me your json if you want to translate it and I'll add your translation to this mod (instead of you making a new translation mod)

[/size][size=3][size=5][size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size] Feedback [size=3][size=5][size=5]💰[/size][/size][/size]
[/size][/size][size=3]Please report bugs in the Bugs tab, not in Posts. If you find a bug, please send a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] with it. Requests and suggestions can go in Posts.
